results.name: row mapping (hand values): board (24,24) → strip (24,24); row 1 (y=229) → S = 912 + x; strip → board inverts every on-grid board point
strip frames: element ↔ (u,v) are inverse rotations (det +1, no mirror) for rot 0 / 90 / −90 and the CSS matrix matches the math
infinite pins: rows in use + one empty row; max pan reaches every pin and the empty row; panToShow brings any pin fully into view
lifted pose (slant camera, 6 viewports × 4 walls): projects EXACTLY onto the dock rectangle, in front of every resting face, inside the frame, cards ≥ 24 px and names ≥ 9 px
pointer mapping: screen → element through the face's quad inverts element → screen (rest quads of both cameras and lifted quads), and surfaceAt follows paint order
resting pins: a pin is a pointer target only where its projected box is ≥ 24 px both ways — north band yes at 1440, side slivers no (they lift instead)
fan along the strip: n cards, increasing S, no overlap beyond 14 %, centred on the pile, never before S = 0
mutants: each seeded defect in the geometry is caught by the checks above
